paragraphs: He is mentioned in Pesachim 106b, asking Rav Huna; Hyman reports that Dikdukei Soferim reads Rav Chana bar Ketina.[^1]

notes.text: The William Davidson Pesachim 106b paragraph explicitly has Rav Chana bar Chinena asking Rav Huna, supporting the local expansion of ר״ה. The Rav Chana bar Ketina reading is Hyman’s report about Dikdukei Soferim; that apparatus has not been freshly collated. The patronymics remain distinct and no correction or identity is adopted.
